make.name: Lincoln
make.description: Ford's luxury brand. As of November 2026 Lincoln has not sold a battery-electric vehicle: a Rivian-based EV announced in 2020 and a planned three-row electric SUV were both dropped, and a small electric crossover on Ford's Universal EV Platform is planned for later this decade.

sources.name: Business Wire: Lincoln and Rivian partner on first Lincoln EV (29 Jan 2020)
Ford Authority: Lincoln to add UEV-based electric crossover (Aug 2026)

gaps: Lincoln has no battery-electric production model. Not modelled because none was ever officially named: the Rivian-platform Lincoln EV (announced Jan 2020, dropped later in 2020), the three-row electric SUV cancelled in Aug 2024 (reported as an Aviator EV), and the UEV-based small crossover reported in Aug 2026.
Ford Authority (Aug 2026) could not be fetched directly (HTTP 403); its content is from a search-result summary.
